{{Quote|Tell me, Captain Xanda, does GAS really intend to charge a bereaved mother with assault? A distraught, ''fifty-kilogram'' mother who resorted to ''slapping'' a Yaka colonel ''three'' times her size&mdash;''after'' she discovered he has been hanging her children on the wall&hellip;as ''office decorations''?|Javis Tyrr to Xanda|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Xanda was a member of [[Galactic Alliance Security]] with [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] who,<ref name="Abyss" /> in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> was stationed at a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite-frozen]] [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jysella Horn]] and [[Valin Horn]] were held and displayed. However, a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|tricked]] [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] into granting a writ that allowed them to visit the Horn siblings.<ref name="Abyss" />

The facility's commander, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]], attempted to provoke the Jedi in front of the press, but Terrik Horn assaulted him, knocking him out. In the ensuing chaos, Xanda led other captains in demanding the arrest of Terrik Horn, but at the prompting of Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] posed a question to Xanda intended to discredit their demand for the arrest of Terrik Horn. However, before Xanda could answer, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] arrived and declared that the Galactic Alliance would not pursue charges against Terrik Horn.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xanda appeared in author [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
